payload.delegate_statement: Russia expected consultation with the de facto authorities and consideration of all Council members’ views. It said it would withhold support for the envoy appointment without agreement from the de facto authorities.
payload.adopted_document: Paragraph 3 asks the Secretary-General to appoint an envoy after consulting Council members, relevant Afghan actors including authorities, women and civil society, the region and the wider international community. Its appointment terms contain no consent requirement.

training.target: Russia made agreement a condition for its own support. The adopted provision calls for consultation with the Afghan authorities and leaves their agreement outside the appointment requirements.

payload.delegate_statement: Speaking for Gabon, Ghana and Mozambique, Ghana described a Special Envoy as a potential complement to UNAMA’s work.
payload.adopted_document: Paragraph 3 requests an envoy with human rights and gender expertise to advance the assessment’s recommendations, preserving the mandate and work of UNAMA and the Special Representative.

training.target: The African members saw a role for the envoy alongside UNAMA. That view is consistent with the adopted clause preserving UNAMA's mandate and work.

payload.delegate_statement: The African members said a new envoy could add to the work of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan.
payload.adopted_document: Paragraph 3 asks for an envoy and leaves the responsibilities and activities of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan in place.

training.target: The African members saw a role for the envoy alongside UNAMA. That view is consistent with the adopted clause preserving UNAMA's mandate and work.

payload.delegate_statement: Speaking for India, the representative warned of diversion under the ISIL and Al-Qaida regime. India had sought proactive involvement by the 1267 Monitoring Team and robust reporting standards and mechanisms. India judged those specific concerns not fully addressed in the adopted text.
payload.adopted_document: At adoption the exemption applied for two years to the 1267/1989/2253 ISIL and Al-Qaida regime, with the Council intending to decide on extension before expiry. The Council requested that providers use reasonable efforts to minimize prohibited benefits to listed persons or entities, including through due diligence. The text gave the 1267 Committee a monitoring role, required sanctions committees to monitor implementation with expert assistance, and requested recurring briefings from the Emergency Relief Coordinator.

training.target: The Council assigned monitoring to the 1267 Committee, while India judged that its call for proactive Monitoring Team involvement and stronger reporting was still not fully addressed.

payload.delegate_statement: India said the adopted text failed to meet in full its requests for a more active role for the 1267 Monitoring Team and more extensive reporting.
payload.adopted_document: The adopted resolution gives the 1267 Committee a responsibility for monitoring how the exemption works.

training.target: The Council assigned monitoring to the 1267 Committee, while India judged that its call for proactive Monitoring Team involvement and stronger reporting was still not fully addressed.
